name: Pankaj Bhalerao
head: AVP - Client Solutions & Strategic Accounts Acquisition, Rishabh Software
text: AVP - Client Solutions & Strategic Accounts Acquisition, Rishabh Software

strengths: Owns strategic account acquisition for US/UK/ANZ, about $5M+ yearly revenue
Services seller (custom software and offshore delivery), 30% YoY account growth
gaps: Role mixes presales and solutioning with hunting, so check the new-logo share
Mid-size SMB/startup client base, no QE-specific track record
screen.next: Ask him to split his $5M into new logos vs. farming, and how many US enterprise logos he opened in the last 2 years

strengths: Sells AI test automation to engineering leaders, so he speaks QE buyer language
Background includes Gartner and HackerEarth, with documented quota over-achievement (112%)
gaps: SaaS product seller, not a services seller, so the deal sizes and motion are different
screen.next: Pitch it as a move from tool sales to QE services sales and test his appetite for longer, larger services deals

name: Pooja Gundewar
head: Sales & BD, AArete (management and technology consulting)
text: Sales & BD, AArete (management and technology consulting)

strengths: Sells data, cloud and AI transformation deals across multiple verticals
Experience with new-logo acquisition for Microsoft and staffing services
gaps: Consulting/data focus, no QE or GCC exposure
screen.next: Keep warm for a junior client-partner slot. Confirm total years.

name: Sandeep Kathare
head: Large Enterprise Account Executive, Testsigma (ex-BrowserStack, Dell/VMware)
text: Large Enterprise Account Executive, Testsigma (ex-BrowserStack, Dell/VMware)

strengths: Has worked the testing-tools market at both BrowserStack and Testsigma with large enterprises, so he knows QE buyers
gaps: 19 years is well over the 8-15 band
Career is all product/license sales, with no services P&L
screen.next: Use him for referrals into QE buyer networks rather than as a direct fit
